name: AI Image Generator by RunComfy
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
AI Image Generator by RunComfy creates images from text and supported reference images using models available through RunComfy, including FLUX, Nano Banana and Qwen image models.

What you can do:
• Turn a written description into illustrations, concept art and other still images.
• Use a reference image with a compatible model to create a new composition.
• Create character or scene variations, with checks for the details you want to preserve.
• Choose available image dimensions and model options, then retrieve the result or check an existing generation.

Connect a RunComfy account to use the generation tools. Generations use your RunComfy account balance. Available models and settings depend on the current catalog and the selected model.

Reference images must be available through an accessible HTTPS link. If a chat attachment cannot be passed to the model, the plugin asks for a usable image link before generating. Generated variations can change identity, text or fine details; inspect the result before using it.
